newsitem.title: USA: Edison to start San Onofre 3 nuke refuel April 12.
newsitem.headline: Edison to start San Onofre 3 nuke refuel April 12.

text.p: The 1,080 megawatt (MW) unit 3 at the San Onofre nuclear power plant in southern California will begin refueling April 12, not April 5 as Southern California Edison Co said previously, a company spokesman said Monday.
The outage is expected to last 65 days.

Meanwhile, San Onofre's 1,070 MW unit 2, which was shut for planned refuelng and maintenance on November 30, was originally expected to restart early last month, but has been kept out of service for additional repairs.
Edison estimated unit 2 will restart March 20.
The San Onofre plant is majority owned and operated by Edison, while Enova Corp's San Diego Gas and Electric Co owns 20 percent and the cities of Anaheim and Riverside own the remaining five percent.
